region: AWS us-east-1 (N. Virginia), on-demand, Linux, single-AZ
caveat: List prices as reported by third-party price aggregators on the access date (AWS's own pricing pages could not be read programmatically). Prices change; check the AWS pricing pages for your region before budgeting. Taxes, support plans, reserved or spot discounts, backups beyond the free allowance, and TLS/load-balancer costs are not included.

server.note: Burstable: 20 % of each vCPU (0.4 vCPU in total) is the sustained baseline; more consumes CPU credits. t4g is arm64 (Graviton); the benchmark measured CPU on an x86_64 host, so the fit against the baseline is a projection, not a measurement on this instance.

database.sku: RDS for PostgreSQL db.t4g.micro (2 vCPU burstable, 1 GiB), single-AZ

database_storage.sku: RDS gp3 storage, 20 GB (the RDS minimum)

redis.sku: ElastiCache for Redis OSS cache.t4g.micro (0.5 GiB), one node

egress.sku: Data transfer out to the internet
egress.note: Rate for the first 10 TB a month after the free 100 GB.

assumptions.why: Traffic that depends on how an application is used rather than on Checkgate: how often flags change, and how often each client's stream is re-established (app restarts, deploys, network changes). Each reconnect re-sends the full flag set. Change them to fit your deployment; the measured per-event costs do not change.
